name: allocated-slash
title: Allocated slash
question: What changes if a conviction burns only the WOOD allocated to that proposal?
note: Today slashBpsFor returns a flat 10000 for every approver with a live pledge, clamped into [minSlashBps, maxSlashBps] = [1000, 10000], and DeployPlanB hard-requires maxSlashBps == 10000 -- so every approver loses 100% of their at-anchor stake regardless of how much coverage they carried. Under SHE-232 only the allocated share burns. The depositor still receives nothing either way.
